blocks.text: Yeh Unit 12 (Limit and Continuity) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.
12.1.1 Meaning of the Phrase "x approaches zero"

blocks.prompt:
1 Show that the terms of \(x_{n} = \frac{1}{2n}\) approach \(0\), and find after which position every term is smaller than \(0.001\).
(Dikhayein ke \(x_{n} = \frac{1}{2n}\) ki terms \(0\) ki taraf jati hain, aur batayein kis position ke baad har term \(0.001\) se chhoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Terms: \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{4}, \frac{1}{6}, \ldots\) \(n\) barhne se jitni chahein chhoti ho jati hain, is liye \(n \to \infty\) par \(x_{n} \to 0\). \(\frac{1}{2n} < 0.001 \Leftrightarrow 2n > 1000 \Leftrightarrow n > 500\): 500vi term ke baad har term.

book_ref.quote: becoming closer and closer to

blocks.prompt:

(Wazeh karein ke \(x_{n} = 2^{n}\) infinity ki taraf kyun jati hai, aur pehla \(n\) maloom karein jis ke liye \(x_{n} > 1000\).)
blocks.explanation: \(2, 4, 8, 16, \ldots\) beghair had barhti hain aur jitni chahein bari ho sakti hain, is liye \(x_{n} \to \infty\). \(2^{9} = 512\), \(2^{10} = 1024 > 1000\): pehla \(n = 10\).

blocks.text: 12.1.5 Limit of a Function

blocks.prompt:
7 Define the limit of a function.
(Function ki limit ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farz karein \(f(x)\), \(a\) ke qareeb open interval mein defined hai (\(a\) par zaroori nahi). Agar \(x\) ke \(a\) ki taraf dono taraf se jane par \(f(x)\) aik khaas number \(L\) ki taraf jaye to \(L\) ko \(x \to a\) par \(f(x)\) ki limit kehte hain: \(\lim_{x \to a} f(x) = L\).

book_ref.quote: be defined in an open interval near the number

blocks.text: 12.1.6 Theorems on Limits of Functions

blocks.prompt:
8 State the theorem on the limit of a quotient of two functions.
(Do functions ke quotient ki limit wali theorem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(\lim_{x \to a} f(x) = L\) aur \(\lim_{x \to a} g(x) = M\) ho to \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)} = \frac{L}{M}\), basharte \(a\) ke qareeb \(g(x) \ne 0\) aur \(M \ne 0\).

book_ref.quote: The limit of the quotient of the functions is equal to the quotient of their limits

(Theorems on limits se \(\lim_{x \to -2}(x^{3} + 4x - 1)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The limit of the sum of two functions is equal to the sum of their limits.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.text: 12.2.8 The Sandwich Theorem

blocks.prompt:
40 State the Sandwich Theorem.
(Sandwich Theorem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farz karein \(c\) wale kisi open interval mein (shayad \(c\) ke ilawa) tamam \(x\) ke liye \(f(x) \le g(x) \le h(x)\). Agar \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) aur \(\lim_{x \to c} h(x) = L\) ho to \(\lim_{x \to c} g(x) = L\).

book_ref.quote: for all numbers \(x\) in some open interval containing

blocks.prompt:
41 Use the Sandwich Theorem to find \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^{2}\cos\frac{1}{x}\).
(Sandwich Theorem se \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^{2}\cos\frac{1}{x}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(-1 \le \cos\frac{1}{x} \le 1\) aur \(x^{2} \ge 0\) se \(-x^{2} \le x^{2}\cos\frac{1}{x} \le x^{2}\). Dono \(-x^{2}\) aur \(x^{2}\), \(0\) ki taraf jate hain, is liye limit \(0\).

book_ref.quote: Many limit problems arise that cannot be directly evaluated by algebraic techniques.

blocks.text: 12.3.1 One-Sided Limits

blocks.prompt:
46 Define the left hand limit and the right hand limit of \(f(x)\) at \(c\).
(\(c\) par \(f(x)\) ki left hand limit aur right hand limit ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x) = L\): \(c\) ke kaafi qareeb magar \(c\) se chhote tamam \(x\) ke liye \(f(x)\) jitna chahein \(L\) ke qareeb ho sakta hai. \(\lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x) = M\): \(c\) ke kaafi qareeb magar \(c\) se bare tamam \(x\) ke liye \(f(x)\) jitna chahein \(M\) ke qareeb ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: for all \(x\) sufficiently close to \(c\), but less than \(c\)

blocks.prompt:

(\(x < 3\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} - 2\) aur \(x \ge 3\) par \(f(x) = 2x + 1\) ho to \(x = 3\) par left aur right hand limits nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The rules for calculating the left hand and the right hand limits are the same

blocks.text: 12.3.2 Criterion for Existence of Limit of a Function

blocks.prompt:
48 Show that \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{|x + 2|}{x + 2}\) does not exist.
(Dikhayein ke \(\lim_{x \to -2}\frac{|x + 2|}{x + 2}\) exist nahi karti.)
blocks.explanation: \(x < -2\) par \(|x + 2| = -(x + 2)\), is liye LHL \(= -1\). \(x > -2\) par \(|x + 2| = x + 2\), is liye RHL \(= 1\). \(-1 \ne 1\), is liye limit exist nahi karti.

book_ref.quote: exactly when the left hand limit and the right hand limit both exist and both equal

blocks.prompt:
49 Find \(k\) so that \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) exists, where \(f(x) = kx + 1\) for \(x < 2\) and \(f(x) = x^{2} - 1\) for \(x > 2\).
(\(k\) maloom karein taake \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) exist kare, jahan \(x < 2\) par \(f(x) = kx + 1\) aur \(x > 2\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} - 1\).)
blocks.explanation: LHL \(= 2k + 1\), RHL \(= 4 - 1 = 3\). Limit tab exist karti hai jab \(2k + 1 = 3\), yani \(k = 1\).

book_ref.quote: Method: \(x = 2\) and \(x = 4\) are the points where the formula changes

blocks.text: 12.3.3 Continuity of a Function at a Point

blocks.prompt:
50 When is a function \(f\) said to be continuous at \(x = c\)?
(Function \(f\) ko \(x = c\) par continuous (musalsal) kab kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(f\), \(c\) par continuous hai agar aur sirf agar (i) \(f(c)\) defined ho, (ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exist kare, (iii) \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)\). Koi aik bhi shart na ho to \(f\), \(c\) par discontinuous hai.

book_ref.quote: if and only if the following three conditions are satisfied

blocks.prompt:

(Kya \(f(x) = \frac{x^{2} - 25}{x - 5}\), \(x = 5\) par continuous hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. \(f(5) = \frac{0}{0}\) defined nahi, is liye shart (i) poori nahi aur \(f\), \(x = 5\) par discontinuous hai (halanke \(\lim_{x \to 5} f(x) = 10\)).

book_ref.quote: If one or more of these three conditions fail to hold

(\(x \le 1\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\), \(x > 1\) par \(f(x) = 3x - 1\): \(x = 1\) par continuity par behas karein.)

book_ref.quote: Discuss continuity of \(f(x)\) at \(x = 3\), when

blocks.text: 12.4 Application of Transcendental Functions to Limits and Continuity on Real World Problems

blocks.prompt:

(Aik maddah \(A(t) = 80e^{-0.05t}\) (gram) ke mutabiq decay hota hai. \(A(20)\) aur \(\lim_{t \to \infty} A(t)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The radioactive decay of a substance is given by the function

blocks.prompt:
55 An investment grows as \(A(t) = 2000e^{0.08t}\) (rupees). Find \(A(25)\) and the limit as \(t \to \infty\).
(Aik investment \(A(t) = 2000e^{0.08t}\) (rupay) ke mutabiq barhti hai. \(A(25)\) aur \(t \to \infty\) par limit nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(A(25) = 2000e^{2} \approx 14778.11\) rupay. \(0.08t \to \infty\), is liye \(e^{0.08t} \to \infty\) aur \(\lim_{t \to \infty} A(t) = \infty\): qeemat beghair had barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: The value of an investment grows according to the formula for continuous compounding

blocks.prompt:
56 The demand function is \(D(p) = \frac{500}{2p + 5}\). Find \(\lim_{p \to \infty} D(p)\) and interpret it.
(Demand function \(D(p) = \frac{500}{2p + 5}\) hai. \(\lim_{p \to \infty} D(p)\) nikalein aur matlab batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{500/p}{2 + 5/p} \to \frac{0}{2} = 0\). Qeemat bohat bari ho jaye to demand \(0\) ki taraf jati hai.

book_ref.quote: the demand function \(D(p)\) decreases as the price \(p\) increases

blocks.prompt:
57 A cost function is \(C(x) = 8x + 200\) for \(x \le 50\) and \(C(x) = 10x + 100\) for \(x > 50\). Is it continuous at \(x = 50\)?
(Cost function \(x \le 50\) par \(C(x) = 8x + 200\) aur \(x > 50\) par \(C(x) = 10x + 100\) hai. Kya yeh \(x = 50\) par continuous hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(C(50) = 400 + 200 = 600\); LHL \(= 600\); RHL \(= 500 + 100 = 600\). Sab barabar, is liye \(C\), \(x = 50\) par continuous hai.
